notes.title: The Revolt: Awakening - Update 0.8.6
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/ed1f8788542facfe6a7277e5b755c88c12efac75.png

Hi everyone,

Hi everyone, here's a little patch in preparation for the next content as well as some player feedback!

fixes:

  Some level design have been adjusted and/or modified.
  Fixed a bug that allowed the player to jump during a slide.


Adjustments:

  The player's speed will no longer be affected by explosions.
  Enemies in close combat can no longer cause the player to bleed.
  Some areas have been modified to be more understandable for the player.
  Added a new path and adjusted the tank's life points in mission 2.


Thanks to all the players who play The Revolt: Awakening!

notes.title: The Revolt: Awakening - Update 0.8.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/ed1f8788542facfe6a7277e5b755c88c12efac75.png

Hi everyone,

Following some feedback on the difficulty of certain levels and enemies, several game desgin elements have been modified to make the player experience more enjoyable.

fixes:

  Some level design have been adjusted.
  Fixed the enemy path in some dungeon arenas.


Adjustments:

  The damage of the train turret has been reduced from 30 to 25.
  The damage resistance bonus for enemies in dungeons has been greatly reduced (by about 75%).
  Less enemies in dungeons and arenas.


Thanks to all the players who play The Revolt: Awakening!

notes.title: The Revolt: Awakening - Update 0.8.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/ed1f8788542facfe6a7277e5b755c88c12efac75.png

Hi everyone,

It's been a month now that my game has been available on steam. Thanks to all the players who bought and played my game!

Additions:

 Added a new weapon: m8 silenced rifle.
 Added more "personal safe" in Resistance camps to secure your loots more often.


fixes:

  The player could exit the arena against the boss of the train.


Adjustments:

  The damage of toxic gas goes from 8 to 7 per tic.
  The number of tic of the toxic gas passes from 6 to 4.
  Sometimes you couldn't use your weapon when you were too close to a wall.
  Modified the level design on some quests.
  Highlighting of platforms in the boss's arena.


A new weapon arrives in the game!

notes.title: The Revolt: Awakening - Update 0.8.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/ed1f8788542facfe6a7277e5b755c88c12efac75.png

Hi everyone,

Here's another update with some minor corrections, adjustments and additions!

Additions:

 A new scene has been added on the train level to initiate the player to one of the boss's mechanics.
 A checkpoint has been added before the alert at the end of mission 2.


Fixes:

  The train boss checkpoint was not recording the inventory content.
  The player could take damage during the dialog.
  The red fires disappeared during the fight with the boss of the train.
  Upgrading a weapon could cause the game to crash.


Adjustments:

  The train's napalm grenade can be destroyed in mid-air.
  The platforms of the train boss have been redesigned to be more visible to the player.
  Heavy gunner soldiers fire fewer bullets per attack and their damage is reduced from 6 to 5 (per bullet).
  The respawn time of enemies in the open world is now of 3mn (instead of 1mn).
  Modification of level design for the pit in the dungeon "iron trap".
  The interaction icon has been modified for pnj's that need to hold the key.
  The health points of the tank goes from 5000 to 5500.

notes.title: The Revolt: Awakening - Update 0.8.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/ed1f8788542facfe6a7277e5b755c88c12efac75.png

Hi everyone,

Thanks for all your feedback on the game, I'm very glad that so many people like it!
I've made a little update with some bugs fixes and adjustments.

Fixes:

 Some achievement were not in the chosen language.
 Correction of the game freeze when you finished a main quest


Adjustements:

 The respawn time of enemies in the open world is now of 1mn (instead of 25s)

notes.title: Release date for Autumn ?
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/d6993c5bf0e31aa1ab7c195f8d51a778448ae3f4.png


After reviewing what I still have to do to release the game, I came to the conclusion that a release date for the autumn period is very possible! Indeed most of the mechanics of the game are ready, the big points of the moment are optimization, balancing, bugs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010119/90d9e83ecc9ad647cb4e160b6eceb1be263a8e51.gif


Since a few days a CLOSED BETA is in progress to make the first tests and ensure that the core of the game and its concept works well.

During the coming weeks and months I will keep you informed of the progress of certain features and will present you with elements of the game as well as their operation.

If you haven't seen it yet I give you the last trailer of the game!

[previewyoutube=kr3x1NHMJl0;full][/previewyoutube]
Do not hesitate to like and share about the game on social media!

You can also follow me on the official discord of The Revolt: Awakening.
